customer_name: State Grid Xinjiang Electric Power Co., Ltd.
business_problem: State Grid Xinjiang needed a safer and more scalable way to monitor transmission lines, replace manual inspections and centralize real-time operational control across its power-grid infrastructure.
solution_summary: State Grid Xinjiang adopted Baidu AI Cloud's cloud-plus-AI stack to build a smart inspection and control environment for power infrastructure. At the center is a data-processing and control hub that aggregates inspection results, device telemetry and command execution records and projects them onto a 3D transmission-line model so operators can watch grid status in real time. On the edge, the deployment uses low-power, low-cost recognition capabilities to identify risks quickly enough to replace part of the manual inspection workload, while drone inspection extends coverage over difficult or dangerous routes. The broader AI middle-platform turns those feeds into an operational layer for smart inspection, event visualization and safety management. Instead of waiting for field crews to find faults after the fact, dispatchers gain a continuously updated picture of line conditions and can respond faster while reducing exposure for inspection staff.

solution_components.name: AI Middle Platform Solution
solution_components.role: Coordinates the inspection, monitoring and control workflows for grid operations.

solution_components.name: Data Processing Center
solution_components.role: Stores inspection results, command execution records and real-time status data for operators.

solution_components.name: 3D Line Model
solution_components.role: Visualizes live grid conditions and line topology for centralized monitoring.

solution_components.name: Drone Inspection
solution_components.role: Collects field inspection data while reducing the amount of manual patrol work.

data_flow: Inspection images, recognition outputs and line-status telemetry flow into the data-processing center, where the AI middle platform correlates them with the 3D line model so dispatchers can watch conditions, review patrol outcomes and issue control actions from the central console.
business_outcome: The utility replaced a large share of manual inspections with AI-assisted monitoring, improved operator visibility over line conditions and reduced field-safety exposure while preparing more AI use cases for the power business.
metrics: Drone inspection reduced 60% of manual inspection workload.
